workflow.title: Find the connected risk.
workflow.label: Discover
workflow.summary: See how a cloud exposure and an identity permission can become the same problem.
workflow.description: Bring configuration and access into one model. Follow the relationship to a sensitive resource, then inspect the evidence that makes the path feasible.

workflow.title: Understand what’s at stake.
workflow.label: Understand
workflow.summary: A permission is a starting point. Context tells you what it can reach and who owns it.
workflow.description: Inspect the principal, effective grant, target sensitivity, and owner. Separate observed facts from assumptions before deciding how to act.

workflow.title: Make the smallest safe change.
workflow.label: Intervene
workflow.summary: Give engineering a clear intervention, an owner, and a way to verify the result.
workflow.description: Package the evidence into a reviewable handoff. Test through your normal process, then revisit the relationship after deployment.

teams.label: Cloud security
teams.title: Turn a backlog into a next step.
teams.summary: Follow the paths to your critical assets. Prioritize a change with evidence, ownership, and a clear reason to act.

teams.label: Security operations
teams.title: Follow the signal beyond the alert.
teams.summary: See the environment around a principal. Keep observed activity and possible access distinct throughout the investigation.

teams.label: Platform engineering
teams.title: A change request you can review.
teams.summary: Get the affected resource, the proposed intervention, and its supporting evidence. Keep testing and rollout in your existing workflow.

features.title: See beyond the finding.
features.summary: A cloud issue is one part of the story. Follow the permissions and connections that give it consequence.

features.title: Put every permission in context.
features.summary: Human or machine, an identity should have a purpose, an owner, and an access decision you can explain.

features.title: Give your cloud backlog direction.
features.summary: Configuration findings become more useful when you can see their owner and the assets they may expose.
